Business Requirement Description :
1.Production Statistics:
Production reports, displaying production data for each process. Information to be recorded includes the report type, date, production data, production indicators, completion status, metal recovery rate, and grade.
2.Equipment Management:
Equipment record management, including basic information (name, model, main category, subcategory, location, etc.). Equipment operation status, with real-time monitoring and alarm notifications in case of anomalies.
Equipment inspection management, recording inspection plans and progress, performed by the inspector.
Equipment failure reporting, recording information about the failure, including the reporter’s ID, failure type, failure time, and processing status.
Equipment repair management, handled by repair personnel, recording repair details and progress, and managing repair work orders. Information such as repair progress and repair time should be recorded.
3.Quality Management:
Quality report module, displaying the recovery rate and grade for each metal. Records to include metal recovery rate, incoming warehouse sample, metal grade, recovery rate daily report, and grade daily report.
4.User Management:
For each user in the system, the following details should be recorded: user ID, username, role, permissions, status, and operation history.
5.Announcements:
Announcers can create, publish, delete, and retrieve announcements. Information to record includes announcement content, release time, and announcement status.
6.Job Positions:
The system should register currently available job positions, including position ID, position name, position description, position responsibilities, and job requirements. Users can apply for positions, and the system will record the position match rate.

-- Schema for database: rschema_0255

CREATE TABLE `process` (
  `process_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `process_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `process_description` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`process_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `production_report` (
  `report_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `process_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `report_type` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `report_date` datetime NOT NULL,
  `production_data` decimal(15,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `production_indicator` decimal(15,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `completion_status` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `metal_recovery_rate` decimal(10,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `grade` decimal(10,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`report_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `production_report_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`process_id`) REFERENCES `process` (`process_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `equipment_category` (
  `category_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `category_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `parent_category_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`category_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `equipment_category_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_category_id`) REFERENCES `equipment_category` (`category_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `equipment` (
  `equipment_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `equipment_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `model` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `main_category_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `sub_category_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `location` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`equipment_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `equipment_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`main_category_id`) REFERENCES `equipment_category` (`category_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `equipment_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`sub_category_id`) REFERENCES `equipment_category` (`category_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `equipment_operation_status` (
  `status_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `equipment_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `monitor_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `operation_status` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_anomaly` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `alarm_notification` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`status_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `equipment_operation_status_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`equipment_id`) REFERENCES `equipment` (`equipment_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `user` (
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `role` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `permissions` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `operation_history` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `equipment_inspection_plan` (
  `plan_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `equipment_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `inspector_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `plan_date` datetime NOT NULL,
  `inspection_progress` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `inspection_notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`plan_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `equipment_inspection_plan_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`equipment_id`) REFERENCES `equipment` (`equipment_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `equipment_inspection_plan_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`inspector_id`) REFERENCES `user` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `equipment_failure_report` (
  `failure_report_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `equipment_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `reporter_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `failure_type` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `failure_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `failure_description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `processing_status` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`failure_report_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `equipment_failure_report_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`equipment_id`) REFERENCES `equipment` (`equipment_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `equipment_failure_report_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`reporter_id`) REFERENCES `user` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `equipment_repair_order` (
  `repair_order_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `equipment_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `failure_report_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `repair_personnel_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `repair_details` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `repair_progress` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `repair_start_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `repair_end_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `repair_status` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`repair_order_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `equipment_repair_order_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`equipment_id`) REFERENCES `equipment` (`equipment_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `equipment_repair_order_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`failure_report_id`) REFERENCES `equipment_failure_report` (`failure_report_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `equipment_repair_order_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`repair_personnel_id`) REFERENCES `user` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `metal` (
  `metal_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `metal_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `metal_description` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`metal_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `quality_report` (
  `quality_report_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `metal_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `report_date` datetime NOT NULL,
  `metal_recovery_rate` decimal(10,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `incoming_warehouse_sample` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `metal_grade` decimal(10,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `recovery_rate_daily_report` decimal(10,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `grade_daily_report` decimal(10,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`quality_report_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `quality_report_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`metal_id`) REFERENCES `metal` (`metal_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `announcement` (
  `announcement_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `announcer_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `release_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `announcement_status` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`announcement_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `announcement_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`announcer_id`) REFERENCES `user` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `job_position` (
  `position_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `position_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `position_description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `position_responsibilities` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `job_requirements` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`position_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `job_application` (
  `application_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `position_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `application_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `match_rate` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `application_status` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`application_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `job_application_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `user` (`user_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `job_application_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`position_id`) REFERENCES `job_position` (`position_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
